annotations.title: Verify the Teams chat-service token and API end-to-end

description: Resolves the credential the way real tools do, then makes one authenticated request to teams.cloud.microsoft. Reports which source supplied the credential, whether teams.cloud.microsoft accepted it, the round-trip time, and a plain-English hint distinguishing 'no credential' from 'credential rejected' from 'a teams.cloud.microsoft-side problem'. Read-only; never returns the credential itself. The credential is the Teams chat-service token behind every tool; the probe is one conversations listing. Also reports the token's source (browser capture through the ContextMint Bridge, or TEAMS_ACCESS_TOKEN), its expiry, and how many conversations the listing returned — never the token itself. Call this when a real tool fails and you want to know which hop broke.
name: teams_healthcheck
